notes.title: November Update - Controller Support!
notes.notes:
Hey, just had a neurotic realization that I could add controller support, and guess what? I did!

Red Genie now has gamepad support, so you can change the controls to fit whatever Gamepad you have! I tested it with my own Xbox controller, so hopefully it works out for you guys!

Also made some minor balance adjustments to some less-used equipment, so I hope the buffs are fun for you all!

Happy adventuring, friends!

-ODaM

notes.title: 2024 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello all! I made an update for this year and before summer fully arrives! Here's the list of notes based on things players brought to my attention!

- Some weapons have had their stats adjusted to improve usability
- Ambience has been made louder in many areas to ensure they can be heard
- Some enemies have had their stats adjusted to polish balance

The changes are small but ripple through the game in large ways. I find it hard to make massive changes, or add anything to the story or game world because I believe this game is, in my eyes, complete. I think this experience is right where it should be, a fun and digestible RPG that doesn't overstay its welcome.

If there are any bugs or crashes, or there are any issues that you wish to bring to my attention, I am more than happy to hear and try to fix them up! But above all, if you enjoyed this game, please let me know that as well.

-Officer DaMickey

notes.title: Update for October 12th
notes.notes:
I tried to fix up some stuff, a smaller bug fix sweep this time!

-Text errors caught
-Incorrect portrait in mid-battle cutscenes for a boss fight

notes.title: Update? Bug fixes! Please send if they didn't work!
notes.notes:
I made some adjustments to the game, and I am uncertain if things actually got changed?

-Typo fixes on certain spells/Techniques

-Stairwell in Enin does not clip you into a wall anymore (to my knowledge)

-Very Important Boss Battle cannot be repeated now after victory

-Armor Drop Rate slightly adjusted on certain end-game enemy

If anyone catches any issues, just let me know! I'll try my best to fix things when I can!

notes.title: Update Went Live and Borked a LOT of things
notes.notes:
I went to update the game, and it kind of...broke.

If you have the game installed, you need to uninstall and reinstall the game in order for it to work. The build just broke, and just trying to update a few minor issues caused the build to not work entirely.

This also deletes save files, and is a major problem. For anyone who has lost progress due to this update, I apologize greatly for this inconvenience.

This update fixed a few issues, and was meant to be a small and quick fix. The game still runs properly through Steam (I have confirmed through numerous sources) but this still sucks for everyone.

Hope everyone still has fun playing Red Genie! Sorry for the inconvenience!

-ODaM
